# Billing, invoices and refunds

Plans are billed monthly or annually. An invoice is issued on the first day of each
billing period.

## Proration when you change plans

When you upgrade mid-cycle, the invoice shows proration: unused time on the old plan
is credited, and the new plan is charged from the upgrade date. Downgrades take
effect at the end of the current period, so no proration is needed.

## Refunds

Refunds are available within 14 days of an invoice for annual plans. A refund is
returned to the original payment method within five business days. Contact billing
support with the invoice number to request a refund.

## Payment methods

We accept cards and bank transfer. Bank transfer requires a minimum annual commitment
and is invoiced in advance.
